$comment: 外部語彙に載っているが、WIM UI では部品にせず『既存の部品で組む』ものの単一ソース（2026-11-21）。`aliases` は『他所の名前 → 同じ部品』、`not-planned.json` は『他所の名前 → 採らない理由』、こちらは『他所の名前 → 組み方』を答える。llms.txt の『Not a component — compose it』節に出る。部品にしない理由は docs/rules/implementation.md の「複合 UI / レシピ優先」。需要（要る画面か利用者の要望）が出たら、Patterns のレシピにするか、部品にするかを決め直す。check:aliases が、名前と別表記が既存の部品・別名・採らないの語とぶつからないこと、use の部品が実在することを見る。

$fields.name: 外部の体系で使われている呼び名（見出しになる）
$fields.aka: 同じものを指す別表記
$fields.en: llms.txt 用。何をどう組むかを英語で。prop を書くときは実在するものだけ
$fields.ja: 人が読む用。組み方を日本語で
$fields.use: 組むのに使う WIM の部品（実在するコンポーネント名）

composable.name: Radio Card
composable.en: A card-shaped choice. Put a `Radio` (one choice) or `Checkbox` (several) with its label and description inside a `Card`, and group them with `RadioGroup` / `CheckboxGroup` so the keyboard and form value stay native.
composable.ja: `Card` の中に `Radio`（1 つ選ぶ）か `Checkbox`（いくつも選ぶ）とラベル・説明を置き、`RadioGroup` / `CheckboxGroup` でまとめる。キー操作とフォームの値は素のまま

composable.name: Native Select
composable.en: Use a plain `<select>` element; when it must match WIM styling and behaviour, use `Select`.
composable.ja: 素の `<select>` を使う。見た目と振る舞いを揃えるなら `Select`

composable.name: Toggle Button
composable.en: A single press-and-stay button (`aria-pressed`): a `ToggleGroup` with `selectionMode="multiple"` and one option. For an on/off setting, use `Switch`.
composable.ja: 押したままになるボタン（`aria-pressed`）は、`ToggleGroup` の `selectionMode="multiple"` に項目を 1 つ。設定のオン・オフなら `Switch`

composable.name: Collapsible
composable.en: A single show/hide section: an `Accordion` with one item and `collapsible`.
composable.ja: `Accordion` に項目を 1 つ、`collapsible` を付ける

composable.name: Navigation Menu
composable.en: Site-level navigation with dropdown panels: a row of `Dropdown`s whose items are links, inside `Navbar` or `Header`.
composable.ja: `Navbar` か `Header` の中に、項目がリンクの `Dropdown` を並べる

composable.name: Navigation Progress
composable.en: A thin bar at the top of the page while a route loads: a `Progress` (use `indeterminate` when the duration is unknown) kept at the top edge with `Affix` (`offsetTop={0}`).
composable.ja: `Progress`（長さが分からないときは `indeterminate`）を `Affix`（`offsetTop={0}`）で上端に置く

composable.name: Timezone Select
composable.en: A searchable list of time zones: a `Combobox` whose `options` come from `Intl.supportedValuesOf("timeZone")`.
composable.ja: `Combobox` の `options` に `Intl.supportedValuesOf("timeZone")` を渡す

composable.name: Swap
composable.en: Swapping one icon for another (open/close chevron, play/pause): render the two `Icon`s conditionally and animate the change with `Transition`. Keep the accessible name on the button, not the icon.
composable.ja: 2 つの `Icon` を状態で出し分け、`Transition` で入れ替える。名前はボタンの側に付ける

composable.name: Counter Badge
composable.en: A count such as "99+": pass the text to `Badge`'s `content`. To pin it to the corner of another element, use `Indicator`.
composable.ja: `Badge` の `content` に文字で渡す。ほかの要素の角に付けるなら `Indicator`

composable.name: Compound Button
composable.en: A button with a second line of description: put two lines of text inside `Button` (a short label first, the description in `Text` below it).
composable.ja: `Button` の中に 2 行の文字（短いラベルと、その下に `Text` の説明）

composable.name: Inline Drawer
composable.en: A side panel that pushes the content aside instead of overlaying it: a `Splitter` (resizable) or a `Flex` row whose side pane is shown with `Transition`.
composable.ja: `Splitter`（幅を変えられる）か `Flex` の行に脇の面を置き、`Transition` で出し入れする

composable.name: Expandable Search
composable.en: A search icon that opens into a field: an `IconButton` that reveals a `SearchInput` and moves focus into it.
composable.ja: `IconButton` を押すと `SearchInput` が開き、フォーカスを移す

composable.name: Tearsheet
composable.en: A large task surface over the page: a `Dialog` or a `Drawer` holding the task. Neither has an extra-wide preset, so set the content width with your own class.
composable.ja: `Dialog` か `Drawer` に作業を入れる。どちらも幅の広い既定は無いので、内容の幅は利用者のクラスで決める

composable.name: Notifications Panel
composable.en: A panel listing recent notifications: a `List` inside a `Popover` (from a bell `IconButton`) or a `Drawer`.
composable.ja: ベルの `IconButton` から開く `Popover` か `Drawer` に `List`

composable.name: Guide Banner
composable.en: Onboarding guidance: a dismissible `Banner` in the page, or a `Dialog` containing a `Carousel` of steps for a first-run screen. For pointing at parts of the UI, use `Tour`.
composable.ja: 閉じられる `Banner`、初回の画面なら `Dialog` に手順の `Carousel`。画面の部分を指すなら `Tour`

composable.name: Options Tile
composable.en: A tile that expands to reveal settings: an `Accordion` item styled with the `Card` surface.
composable.ja: `Accordion` の項目を `Card` の見た目で

composable.name: Add Select
composable.en: Picking items from a catalogue to add: a `Dialog` containing `Transfer` (two lists) or `MultiSelect`.
composable.ja: `Dialog` に `Transfer`（2 つの一覧）か `MultiSelect`

composable.name: Chat Button
composable.en: AI-styled controls and loading placeholders: a regular `Button` or `Skeleton` marked with `AILabel`. WIM does not give AI content a separate visual style.
composable.ja: `Button`・`Skeleton` に `AILabel` を添える。AI の中身に別の見た目は付けない

composable.name: Shape Indicator
composable.en: A status shown by shape as well as colour: an `Icon` whose shape differs per status, followed by the status text.
composable.ja: 状態ごとに形の違う `Icon` と、状態の文字

composable.name: Status Dot
composable.en: A coloured dot before a status label: an `Indicator` with `inline`, followed by the status text. Never rely on the colour alone. For a person's availability, use `Presence`.
composable.ja: `Indicator` の `inline` と状態の文字。色だけで分けない。人の在席なら `Presence`

composable.name: Multistep Dialog
composable.en: A dialog that walks through steps: a `Dialog` with a `Stepper` at the top and the current step's content below.
composable.ja: `Dialog` の上に `Stepper`、下にいまの手順の中身

composable.name: Compound Tag
composable.en: A two-part "key: value" tag: put the key and the value as two pieces of text inside one `Tag`.
composable.ja: 1 つの `Tag` の中に、キーと値の 2 つの文字

composable.name: Entity Title
composable.en: An icon, title and subtitle as one unit: `Group` with an `Icon`, a `Title` and a `Text`. For a person, use `Persona`.
composable.ja: `Group` に `Icon`・`Title`・`Text`。人なら `Persona`

composable.name: Index Filters
composable.en: A filter bar above a table: a `SearchInput` plus `Select` / `MultiSelect` controls, with the active filters shown as removable `Chip`s (`onDelete`).
composable.ja: `SearchInput` と `Select` / `MultiSelect`、効いている絞り込みは外せる `Chip`（`onDelete`）で

composable.name: Contextual Save Bar
composable.en: A bar announcing unsaved changes with Save and Discard: a `Banner` (or content kept in view with `Affix`) holding two `Button`s.
composable.ja: `Banner`（か `Affix` で見えたままにした面）に 2 つの `Button`

composable.name: Data View
composable.en: Switching a collection between list and grid: a `SegmentedControl` that swaps between `List` and `SimpleGrid`.
composable.ja: `SegmentedControl` で `List` と `SimpleGrid` を切り替える

composable.name: Callout Card
composable.en: A promotional card with an illustration and a call to action: a `Card` with an `Image` and a `Button`.
composable.ja: `Card` に `Image` と `Button`

composable.name: Slider Input
composable.en: A slider with a number field beside it: a `Slider` and a `NumberInput` bound to the same value.
composable.ja: `Slider` と `NumberInput` を同じ値に繋ぐ
